[[File:Port Piscarilius symbol.png|left|120px]]
'''Port Piscarilius''' is one of the five cities in the Kingdom of [[Great Kourend]]. Led by [[Lady Shauna Piscarilius]] of the Piscarilius House, the city is a port primarily inhabited by fishermen who rely on the fishing industry for their source of income, in addition to overseas trade. All visitors from the mainland often come through here or [[Land's End]].

The port is known for its high crime rate, with newcomers to the kingdom warning other new arrivals of the thieves that run rampant in Port Piscarilius. This is due to the political corruption within the Piscarilius authorities, allowing thieves and smugglers such as [[Captain Khaled]] to steal artefacts from houses in the residential district through bribery, and shipping the stolen goods overseas. It can be accessed by travelling by boat by talking to [[Veos]] in Port Sarim. 

==Transportation==
There are several methods to quickly reach Port Piscarilius:
* [[Veos]] or [[Cabin Boy Herbert]] - ship from [[Port Sarim]] or [[Land's End]], then run west and north.
* [[Kharedst's memoirs]] or [[Book of the Dead]] - [[The Fisher's Flute]] teleport (requires completion of [[The Queen of Thieves]]).
* [[Lovakengj Minecart Network]] - Travel to the Port Piscarilius station (20 [[coins]] per ride, or completion of [[The Forsaken Tower]]).
* [[Kourend Castle Teleport]] or [[Xeric's talisman]] to Xeric's Heart - Run east past [[Kingstown]], then north along the coast.
* The [[fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|AKR}} to Hosidius near the [[Tithe Farm]] minigame, then run north. A faster alternative is to run south instead and take the [[Lovakengj Minecart Network]] cart to Port Piscarillius for 20 coins, located just south of Tithe Farm.
* [[Tithe Farm]] [[Minigame Teleport]], then run north. Must have entered the minigame at least once before, which requires Lvl 34 Farming.

==Stealing artefacts==
{{main|Stealing artefacts}}
At level 49 [[Thieving]], [[Captain Khaled]] will assign players to steal artefacts from houses in the Piscarilius area.

==Features==
===Port Piscarilius bank===
{{main|Port Piscarilius bank}}
===Tynan's Fishing Supplies===
{{main|Tynan's Fishing Supplies}}
[[Tynan]] sells basic fishing supplies, including [[sandworms]], which are required for catching [[anglerfish]]. This is the only way to buy sandworms other than from the [[Grand Exchange]] or other players.

===Leenz's General Supplies===
{{main|Leenz's General Supplies}}
[[Leenz]]'s shop is a [[general store]] that sells the usual general store items, including [[bronze nails]] and [[iron nails]].

===Frankie's Fishing Emporium===
{{main|Frankie's Fishing Emporium}}
[[Frankie]]'s shop sells various types of [[fish|raw fish]].

===Fishing Cranes===
{{main|Fishing Crane}}
Broken fishing cranes can be repaired with planks to train [[Crafting]] and [[Construction]].

==Sailing info==
[[File:Port Piscarilius icon detail.png|right|130px]]
Players can [[mooring point|dock]] at Port Piscarilius with level 15 [[Sailing]], provided they have visited Kourend at least once before docking. The furthest dock at the southern end of the town offers the following utilities for sailors:
*[[File:Shipwright map icon.png|link=Shipwright]] [[Shipwright]]
*[[File:Port task board icon.png|link=Notice board]] [[Notice board]]
*[[File:Salvaging station map icon.png|link=Salvaging station]] [[Salvaging station]]
*[[File:Ledger table icon.png|link=Ledger table]] [[Ledger table]]
*[[File:Bank icon.png|link=Bank deposit box]] [[Bank deposit box]]

==Charter ship==
The [[charter ship]]s also have a dock in the harbour in Port Piscarilius. It provides rides to several other locations. After completing [[Cabin Fever]], the charter ship fare is reduced by 50%. Wearing the [[Ring of Charos(a)]] also reduces the fare by 50%. These two bonuses can be stacked to reduce the cost to 25%.

==Trivia==
*Piscarilius is named after Pisces, the Latin plural for fish, and changing syllables from the name [[Piscatoris]].
*Upon release, speaking to various NPCs within Port Piscarilius will reveal that the Port Piscarilius is governed by a Lord Piscarilius. However, with the release of the [[Wintertodt]], speaking to [[Ish the Navigator]] revealed that he was there on Lady Piscarilius' orders. When asked about this inconsistency, Mod Ash stated ''"Having two people share the governance seems like a good idea to me if they also need to make long trade voyages."''{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/774231710401789952|date=9 September 2016|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/101313|archivedate=30 May 2020|quote=Having two people share the governance seems like a good idea to me if they also need to make long trade voyages.}} With [[Update:In Other News (15 June 2017)|an update]] on [[15 June]] [[2017]], all references to Lord Piscarilius were replaced with Lady Piscarilius.
